title: Garlicky alfredo beans

ingredients.name: Parmesan
ingredients.amount: 60g finely grated, plus more to serve

instructions: Thinly slice 8 of the garlic cloves and finely grate the last one. Rinse the beans. Line a small plate with kitchen paper.

In a medium pot over a medium heat, cook the butter and sliced garlic, stirring often, for about 2 minutes. Once the butter foams, keep lifting the garlic to check its colour and cook for about 1 more minute, until it starts to turn golden. Take it out before it darkens: it keeps cooking off the heat.
Lift the garlic chips onto the paper with a slotted spoon and season with salt.

Add the beans, cream, Parmesan and a hefty pinch of salt to the pot and stir. Bring to a simmer over a medium-high heat and cook, stirring gently but often, for about 5 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
Stir in the grated garlic and simmer for 2 minutes, until fragrant. Divide between bowls and top with more Parmesan and the garlic chips.
